pull.title: KAFKA-21287 Fix 'licenses' folder contents and 'LICENSE-binary' file references
pull.body:
**For audit details see this Jira ticket:** KAFKA-21287

**Rationale:**
The `licenses/` folder shipped in the Kafka binary distribution has drifted from the dependencies it covers: one referenced file is missing, one has the wrong license text, four ship for nothing, and several copyright lines are stale. 
CI only compares versions in LICENSE-binary, never the contents of `licenses/`.


___

**Changes (prepared with Claude Code):**

- Restore the "Eclipse Distribution License - v 1.0" section that was
  dropped in KAFKA-20555 (#22232): jakarta.activation-api and
  jakarta.xml.bind-api are EDL 1.0, not CDDL. Also list
  jakarta.activation there, replacing the reference to the
  non-existent licenses/jakarta-BSD-3-clause (added in #18359).
- Move jakarta.servlet-api to EPL 2.0, as declared in its POM. It took
  over the CDDL entry of javax.servlet-api, which is CDDL. Drop the
  now-unused CDDL+GPL-1.1 file.
- Replace the protobuf-java license text (added in #14833 with generic
  wording) with the upstream Google BSD-3 license.
- Remove license files for dependencies that are not bundled:
  mock-oauth2-server (test-only, #19938), jsr305 and paranamer (removed
  from LICENSE-binary in #18943 and #18950).
- Sync classgraph, slf4j, jline, jopt-simple, argparse4j and zstd-jni
  license texts with the upstream tag of the bundled version.
- Fix the Jersey license in NOTICE-binary: Jersey 3.x is available under
  EPL 2.0 (or GPLv2 with the Classpath Exception), not CDDL, and its
  source moved to eclipse-ee4j/jersey.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

KAFKA-21287: Fix 'licenses' folder contents and 'LICENSE-binary' file references

- Restore the "Eclipse Distribution License - v 1.0" section that was
  dropped in KAFKA-20555: jakarta.activation-api and
  jakarta.xml.bind-api are EDL 1.0, not CDDL. Also list
  jakarta.activation there, replacing the reference to the
  non-existent licenses/jakarta-BSD-3-clause.

  over the CDDL entry of javax.servlet-api, which is CDDL. Drop the
  now-unused CDDL+GPL-1.1 file.
- Replace the protobuf-java license text (added in #14833 with generic
  wording) with the upstream Google BSD-3 license.
- Remove license files for dependencies that are not bundled:
  mock-oauth2-server (test-only), jsr305 and paranamer (removed
  from LICENSE-binary).
- Sync classgraph, slf4j, jline, jopt-simple, argparse4j and zstd-jni
  license texts with the upstream tag of the bundled version.
- Fix the Jersey license in NOTICE-binary: Jersey 3.x is available under
  EPL 2.0 (or GPLv2 with the Classpath Exception), not CDDL, and its
  source moved to eclipse-ee4j/jersey.
